name: @oravio/auth
comment: Never installed by an app. Authored source vendored into every app/* by scripts/sync-ui.mjs, so every app stays a flat, standalone Vite project that can be dropped into Lovable directly (same as M5). LoginCard.tsx imports @/components/ui/* from packages/ui, so this package cannot typecheck standalone by design — the real gate is `pnpm --filter @oravio/shell typecheck` (or any synced app) after sync-ui.mjs merges everything into one src/ tree.

scripts.typecheck: echo "template source with cross-package imports — verified via a synced app's typecheck (e.g. apps/shell), not standalone" && exit 0
scripts.build: echo "template source — nothing to build standalone, see typecheck" && exit 0
